name: Kathy Mar
description: '''Kathy Mar''' (from Chinese [[Ma (surname)|{{Transliteration|zh|Ma}}]] by analogy with [[non-rhotic accent]]s) was an American [[filk music|filk]] singer. She co-started an informal movement called The Dandelion Conspiracy to make [[Science fiction convention|general science fiction conventions]] more friendly to filk. A dandelion was chosen to show that filkers would keep coming back to science fiction conventions, like a dandelion in the sidewalk. Thus, the dandelion has become an unofficial filk symbol.
